name: ProSE + PeptDeep Entrapment Benchmark
description: Two arms over the same fixture: baseline (ProSE -> Percolator) vs ProSE with PeptDeep MS2+RT prediction rescoring features. Headline metrics: target PSMs and unique target peptides at 1% FDR, wall time, peak RSS. Entrapment PSMs (protein accessions with the configured prefix) are the false-discovery proxy.
note: Fixture-driven: the mzML and target+entrapment FASTA are supplied via environment variables (PROSE_INPUT, PROSE_FASTA); nothing is vendored or committed. Reference dataset generated by benchmark/prepare_prose_inputs.sh from the OpenMS tree (pinned commit e4b9609c95): target = P02769 (bovine serum albumin); entrapment = real E. coli K-12 target proteins from share/OpenMS/examples/TOPPAS/data/Identification/target_decoy_Ecoli_K12_TaxID_83333.proteomes.fasta renamed ENTRAPMENT_<id> (rev_ decoys excluded; ProSE generates decoys itself via -Search:decoys auto); mzML = FileMerger merge of share/OpenMS/examples/BSA/BSA{1,2,3}.mzML. Search fragment tolerance 0.5 Da (ion-trap CID MS2) applied identically to both arms via PROSE_EXTRA_SEARCH_ARGS. See GSOC_Notebook/Day-31/ProSE_Entrapment_Dataset_Investigation.md.
